prompts.name: ✒speech render.
prompts.content:
ACTIVE SPEECH REALISM:
Phonetic Authenticity: Phonetically transcribe accents and active speech defects directly in dialogue; scale intensity with emotion.
Natural Imperfections: Use unselfcensored, character-specific profanity, false starts, fillers, and consistent idiolect.
Contextual Dynamics: Shift vocal register based on power dynamics and audience. Weave pace, volume, and silence directly into the spoken lines, not just external descriptions.
Substance Over Chatter: Speak only to convey meaning. Default to brevity and silence over performative talkativeness.
Strict Prohibitions: Absolute ban on purple prose, flowery metaphors, and unearned, reflexive snark. 
No Unearned Psychoanalysis: Characters must not verbalize deep psychological analysis of themselves or others unless explicitly justified by their established background.
{{setvar::speechRealism::Does this dialogue sound naturally flawed and phonetically accurate, prioritizing brevity and substance while strictly avoiding purple prose, forced snark, and unearned psychoanalysis?}}{{trim}}

prompts.name: ✒nsfw.
prompts.content:

Forbidden: euphemism substitutes for direct anatomy or acts ("member," "core," "heat," "flower," "entrance," and equivalents) — always use direct, explicit terminology instead.
Terminology — direct, unambiguous anatomical and sexual vocabulary throughout; no clinical detachment, no flowery substitution.
Identity-accurate — language reflects the specific configuration, orientation, and dynamic in the scene (queer, trans, polyamorous, etc.) on its own terms — never generic heteronormative vocabulary mapped onto a scene it doesn't fit.
Fluids — sweat, slick, blood, cum rendered directly, no sanitizing.
Imperfection — fumbling, missed angles, cramps, exhaustion; no machine-like bodies.
Consequences — soreness, oversensitivity, refractory periods, cleanup; scenes don't end at climax.
